astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Comet R3 PanSTARRS Behind Satellite Trails
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Can you find the comet? Somewhere through this web of satellite trails is Comet C/2025 R3 (PanSTARRS), a bright visitor passing through the inner Solar System. Now, the orbiting satellites themselves only appear as streaks because of the long camera exposure, over 10 minutes in this case.
